elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2 gives Customer exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created for Customer; the Deliverable definition includes specified work product created specifically for Customer.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2 states that Vendor assigns all right, title, and interest in each Deliverable to Customer.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 14.3 provides that Vendor retains Vendor Technology, which includes Vendor's pre-existing software, tools, models, templates, documentation, routines, connectors, and other technology.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Sections 14.3 and 13.2 grant a perpetual licence to Vendor Technology incorporated in or required to use a Deliverable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Section 13.2 expressly makes the applicable embedded Vendor Technology licence irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Section 13.2 expressly makes the applicable embedded Vendor Technology licence royalty-free and fully paid.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 14.1 states that, as between the Parties, Customer owns all Customer Data and transfers no rights except the stated limited processing right.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Section 14.1 limits Vendor to processing Customer Data solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer; the defined Services include support, maintenance, corrections, updates, and improvements.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 14.4 creates no jointly owned intellectual property. Its exception requires a separate signed instrument, and no such instrument is supplied.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: Vendor retains Vendor Technology under Section 14.3, while the Deliverable definition excludes generally applicable ideas, methods, skills, and know-how.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The rendered language gives Customer ownership of Deliverables rather than granting a perpetual licence to the Deliverables themselves.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: No irrevocable licence to Deliverables is granted; the irrevocable licence in Section 13.2 applies only to software and Vendor Technology.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: No worldwide licence to Deliverables is granted; the worldwide licence in Section 13.2 applies only to software and Vendor Technology.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: No royalty-free licence to Deliverables is granted; the royalty-free licence in Section 13.2 applies only to software and Vendor Technology.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Customer's exclusive ownership permits use and modification of Deliverables, and Section 13.2 expressly permits use and modification of embedded Vendor Technology for Customer's business.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: There is no express sublicensing right for embedded Vendor Technology; Section 13.2 only permits contractors to support that material for Customer's business.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Section 14.1 limits Vendor to processing Customer Data solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer; the defined Services encompass support, maintenance, corrections, updates, and improvements.
